correctness.rationale: The invariant cube and stochastic-row overlap bound are proved directly. The upper Dini derivative of the activation diameter obeys D+ <= -(1-beta*delta/4)D. At equality strict logistic secant inequality gives D+<0 at every nonuniform state; compactness yields diameter convergence. The perturbed scalar mean has vanishing forcing and finitely many analytic drift zeros, hence approaches a homogeneous fixed point. A reduction of the two-site system to the invariant antisymmetric line proves the exact if-and-only-if onset at beta*delta=4, and a full two-dimensional Jacobian calculation verifies stable heterogeneous equilibria at beta=8, delta=3/4. The cubic local flow yields the sharp t*contrast^2 -> 3/2 endpoint law. The attached standalone checker supplies finite crosschecks, not infinite certification.

value.rationale: Sharp, model-motivated structural classification: a computable row-overlap threshold excludes any persistent heterogeneous state for every finite row-stochastic network, while allowing a genuine hysteretic scalar attractor structure outside the known weak-feedback uniqueness range. The coefficient is shown to be optimal for onset of heterogeneous equilibria in a two-node subfamily; an explicit strictly coupled stable patterned example demonstrates physical relevance. At the boundary a cubic degeneracy gives a sharp inverse-time contrast coefficient 3/2. These are natural dynamical gaps and not arbitrary parameter tabulations.
